package main

// The Unicode fold sets encoding/json matches keys with: every rune that has a fold set other than itself, with the smallest rune of its set
// (encoding/json fold.go foldRune over unicode.SimpleFold). The TypeScript port generates src/s3/fold-table.ts from this file
// (tools/gen-fold-table.mjs); nothing in the table is written by hand.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"unicode"
)

type FoldFile struct {
	Format  string   `json:"format"`
	Go      string   `json:"go"`
	Unicode string   `json:"unicode"`
	Folded  [][2]int `json:"folded"` // [rune, the smallest rune of its fold set], for every rune that is not that rune
}

func foldRuneGo(r rune) rune {
	for {
		r2 := unicode.SimpleFold(r)
		if r2 <= r {
			return r2
		}
		r = r2
	}
}

func foldCorpus(out string) error {
	f := &FoldFile{Format: "certen-sdk/s3-fold-orbits/v1", Go: runtime.Version(), Unicode: unicode.Version}
	for r := rune(0); r <= unicode.MaxRune; r++ {
		if r >= 0xd800 && r < 0xe000 {
			continue
		}
		if m := foldRuneGo(r); m != r {
			f.Folded = append(f.Folded, [2]int{int(r), int(m)})
		}
	}
	if len(f.Folded) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("no fold sets")
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(f)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "fold-orbits.json"), b, 0o644)
}
